title: Left knee hurts after intervals. Can I keep running?
summary:
Q: Left knee hurts after intervals. Can I keep running?
A: Keep easy running on flat ground 2×/week. Replace interval days with cycling or an elliptical so the knee is not loaded at speed. Add quad and hip-stability work twice a week. Stop and book a clinician visit if swelling or night pain appears.
